Logic Analysis: dependency/build; declares core library from src/*.cpp (excluding src/Main.cpp), runtime executable from src/Main.cpp, and single test executable from tests/test_main.cpp; enables testing and registers the test with CTest
runtime/bootstrap; thin, deterministic demo wiring that constructs Game, sets up a simple scenario, queues a few commands, and runs a fixed number of ticks; no IO beyond minimal entrypoint
automated-test; headless deterministic checks for construction/tick wiring and one core rule; includes only declared headers and links against the core library
interface; declares Direction enum, Point, Size, and Geometry helpers (inBounds, advance, rotateLeft, rotateRight)
pure-rule; implements grid math and direction utilities (bounds checks, advancing points, rotations, comparisons)
interface; declares Obstacle, Arena, Tank, Projectile, and Command enum; exposes minimal behavior signatures (e.g., Arena::inBounds/isObstacle/addObstacle, Tank rotations, Projectile step)
domain-entity; implements Arena obstacle checks and management, Tank orientation changes, Projectile stepping; no IO or timing
interface; declares Game orchestration API: construction, reset, queueCommand, tick, accessors for arena/tanks/projectiles/scores/winner
orchestration; implements deterministic tick loop: apply commands (move/rotate/fire), move projectiles, resolve collisions/damage, update scores/winner, maintain pure state transitions
Test Scope Plan: basic construction and tick wiring: create Game, reset, run a few ticks deterministically without side effects
one core rule: projectile fired by a tank advances and reduces opponent tank health on collision (or declares winner if health reaches 0)
Shared Knowledge: Core logic is split into Geometry (grid/direction helpers), Entities (Arena, Tank, Projectile, Command), and Game (deterministic orchestration). Tests include only headers: include/Geometry.h, include/Entities.h, include/Game.h. CMake builds a reusable core library from src/Geometry.cpp, src/Entities.cpp, src/Game.cpp; links src/Main.cpp runtime and tests/test_main.cpp test target against that core. No randomness, IO, or OS/timing dependencies.
Execution Protocol: Run ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure. Runtime entry is src/Main.cpp. Single protocol-level test file is tests/test_main.cpp, which includes declared headers only and links to the core library. Both runtime and test targets link against the core library. No manual interaction; tests are headless and deterministic.
